# Integration branch manifest for the nightly production build.
#
# One branch per line. Lines starting with # or blank lines are ignored.
# The workflow merges these branches in order on top of upstream/master
# (https://github.com/openxe-org/openxe master).
#
# Order matters when branches have dependencies between each other.
# Put foundational branches first, mini-patches last.
#
# To add a new integration branch:
#   1. Push the branch to this fork
#   2. Append its name to this file
#   3. Commit + push on feature/ci-workflow
#
# The next nightly run (or manual workflow_dispatch) will pick it up.
# The ci-workflow branch itself is listed below so the workflow files
# are automatically reintegrated into production on every rebuild.

# CI/CD — keep first so the workflow files are always present on production
feature/ci-workflow

# Core feature modules (full Bootstrap + hook integration)
# feature/lexwareoffice-module -- replaced by feature/lexwareoffice-only:
#   schlanker Cherry-Pick-Branch, der ausschliesslich das LexwareOffice-Modul
#   enthaelt (kein Kommissionierung-/Zahlungsverkehr-/Lieferschwelle-Beifang)
#   plus Init-Setup-Button auf der Settings-Seite, Admin+CSRF-Guard auf allen
#   POST-Pfaden und filesystem-basiertem Master-Key fuer die API-Key-
#   Verschluesselung (V2-Schema mit smooth migration vom Legacy-DB-Salt).
feature/lexwareoffice-only
feature/network-printer-module
feature/supersearch-enhancement
feature/menu-configurator-module

# Larger feature branches (file-based import, some core touch)
feature/upgrader-ui-module
# feature/ticketportal-module  -- temporarily disabled: the portal_*
#   core touch in www/pages/ticket.php is a merge-conflict risk against
#   upstream and the refactor into a dedicated TicketPortalService is
#   still pending. Re-enable once the refactor lands.

# Mini-patches (small core touches, kept as patch branches without Bootstrap)
feature/plz-clean
feature/row-highlight-clean
# fix/woocommerce-variation-support -- superseded by #266 (feature/woocommerce-batch-stock-sync),
#   which replaces ImportSendListLager with products/batch + variations/batch and therefore
#   already covers the variation support. Upstream PR #238 was closed for the same reason.
feature/paid-marking-clean
# mwst_korrektion -- superseded by upstream b57f8461 (eu_steuersatz_zielland_vermerk
#   from 2026-05-04), which solves the same EU B2C VAT-by-destination problem
#   natively via $objSteuersaetze->getTaxesByCountry() and additionally sets
#   steuersatz_zielland=true as a marker. Both implementations patch the same block
#   in www/lib/class.erpapi.php and now conflict. Local 62-line patch became
#   redundant -- re-enable only if upstream's behaviour proves insufficient.

# Supersedes the earlier fix/backup-bootstrap-static (which only fixed BackupTask)
fix/bootstrap-static-cross-check

fix/supersearch-cronjob-undef
# Upgrader UI: replace `git pull` with `git fetch + reset --hard FETCH_HEAD`
# so the in-app upgrade button works even when the remote (production) branch
# is force-pushed by CI.
fix/upgrader-allow-force-pushed-source
# Restore erpAPI::LoadZahlungsweiseModul() — removed by upstream 91e603d

# Branch was rebased onto upstream/master so it now contains only the
# 29-line fix in www/lib/class.erpapi.php (no production-snapshot beifang
